description: This PHP source file defines the PDFWrapper class within the SuiteCRM\PDF namespace. It manages PDF engine configurations, including adding, retrieving, and loading PDF engine classes, and handles external dependencies and configuration settings related to PDF generation.

classes.name: PDFWrapper
classes.description: A class that manages PDF engine configurations, including adding, fetching, and loading PDF engine classes, and retrieving configuration settings.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Adds a new PDF engine to the internal engines array with specified name, file, and class name.

methods.name: getPDFEngine
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of the default or configured PDF engine, loading external configurations if available.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns a list of available PDF engine class names, considering external configuration and PHP version constraints.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Returns the default PDF engine name based on configuration or fallback.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Loads and instantiates a PDF engine class by name, verifying subclassing and file existence.

methods.name: getPDFConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a specific PDF configuration value from the global $sugar_config array.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the configured PDF controller name, if set.
